name: Doximity Dialer Video
one_liner: Free HIPAA-compliant video calling for verified physicians on the Doximity professional network, featuring caller ID masking and no patient app downloads.

short_description: Free HIPAA-compliant video telehealth for verified physicians with caller ID masking and browser-based patient access.
long_description: Doximity Dialer Video is a free telehealth feature available to verified physicians on the Doximity professional network, the largest network of healthcare professionals in the US with over 2 million members. The video calling feature allows physicians to conduct HIPAA-compliant video visits with patients who can join via any web browser without downloading an app or creating an account. A key differentiator is the caller ID masking feature that displays the physician's office number instead of personal phone number, maintaining professional boundaries. Doximity provides a signed BAA at no cost. The platform is designed for simplicity: physicians initiate calls from the Doximity app (iOS/Android) or web, and patients receive an SMS or email link to join. While the free version has limitations compared to paid telehealth platforms (no screen sharing, no session recording, no group calls), it's an excellent option for physicians seeking a straightforward, zero-cost solution for individual video consultations.

faqs.q: Is Doximity Dialer Video really free?
faqs.a: Yes, Doximity Dialer Video is completely free for verified physicians who are members of the Doximity network. There are no per-call fees, monthly charges, or hidden costs. Doximity makes money through other services; basic telehealth is free.

faqs.q: Can therapists and counselors use Doximity?
faqs.a: No, Doximity membership and Dialer Video are only available to verified physicians (MD, DO), nurse practitioners, physician assistants, and medical students. Licensed therapists, counselors, and social workers cannot access the platform.

faqs.q: Does Doximity Dialer Video support group sessions?
faqs.a: No, Doximity Dialer Video is designed for one-on-one video calls between a physician and patient. For group therapy or family sessions, psychiatrists would need to use a different telehealth platform like Zoom for Healthcare.

faqs.q: Can patients join without downloading an app?
faqs.a: Yes, patients join Doximity video calls via any web browser by clicking a link sent via SMS or email. No app download or account creation is required, making it very easy for patients to access care.
